# PathWeave

> PathWeave is a management consulting and advisory firm (founded April 2020) that helps founders and leadership teams strengthen sales, CRM, people and HR systems, processes, data and execution. Brand line: Strategy. Transformation. Growth. PathWeave works with organisations across India; its current on-ground presence includes Hyderabad, Nagpur and Bhopal, with remote consulting support where appropriate.

PathWeave works through four practices — BusinessOS, PeopleOS, Skill HubOS and Government Advisory — connected by the PW-3 Sutra framework (People, Process and Technology designed together). Engagements follow Diagnose, Design, Implement, Enable, Measure. Contact: growth@pathweave.in, +91 77008 83315.

## BusinessOS authority cluster

- [BusinessOS](https://pathweave.in/businessos/): Business, management and technology transformation for growing organisations
- [Sales Transformation](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-transformation/): Integrated change across process, roles, CRM, pipeline, data, governance, management routines and adoption
- [Sales Excellence Operating Model](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-excellence-operating-model/): Sales process, coverage, roles, manager cadence, coaching, incentives and performance governance
- [Commercial Excellence](https://pathweave.in/businessos/commercial-excellence/): Pricing, margin, incentives, channel economics, revenue quality and commercial governance
- [Sales Operations & RevOps](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-operations-revops/): Planning, territories, pipeline governance, CRM discipline, reporting, forecasting and performance management
- [CRM Adoption & Governance](https://pathweave.in/businessos/crm-adoption-governance/): Business ownership, process discipline, data quality, manager routines, rollout, adoption and partner governance
- [Sales Forecasting & Pipeline Governance](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-forecasting-pipeline-governance/): Stage definitions, forecast categories, close-date discipline, manager judgment, review cadence and pipeline hygiene
- [GTM & Channel Execution](https://pathweave.in/businessos/gtm-channel-execution/): Route-to-market, distributor versus direct sales, city expansion, coverage, channel roles, economics and governance
- [Sales Excellence & Commercial Excellence](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-commercial-excellence/): Sales planning, governance, incentives and performance management
- [CRM & Revenue Operations](https://pathweave.in/businessos/crm-revenue-operations/): Sales process, pipeline and CRM on Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365
- [Sales Dashboards & BI](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-dashboards-bi/): KPI frameworks and management dashboards

## PeopleOS authority cluster

### Flagship
- [PeopleOS](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/): People and HR transformation practice
- [HR Consulting for SMEs](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-smes/): Flagship PeopleOS pillar for growing SMEs — organisation and role clarity, manager capability, performance, recruitment, HR operations, HRMS and the right mix of internal, fractional and outsourced HR capacity

### Industry sub-pillars
- [HR Consulting for Startups](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-startups/): Stage-appropriate HR foundations for first hires, roles, managers, performance, people operations and HR ownership
- [HR Consulting for Pharma & Life Sciences](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-pharma-life-sciences/): People systems for specialist and multi-location workforces across technical, operational, corporate and commercial contexts
- [HR Consulting for IT & Technology](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-it-technology/): Specialist hiring, role and career architecture, manager capability, performance systems, distributed people operations and HRMS
- [HR Consulting for GCCs](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-consulting-gccs/): People operating models for GCCs in India, including global-local HR ownership, workforce and role architecture, manager capability, HR service delivery and people data

### Functional authority
- [HR Transformation](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-transformation/): Redesign HR operating models, processes, governance, technology, data, manager routines and adoption
- [HR Operating Model](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-operating-model/): Clarify what HR owns, what managers own, service boundaries, decision rights, governance and capacity model
- [Organisation Design & Role Clarity](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/organisation-design-role-clarity/): Structures, spans, role purpose, accountabilities, decision rights and interfaces
- [Performance Management](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/performance-management/): Expectations, manager check-ins, evidence, calibration, development and follow-through
- [HR Operations & HRMS](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-operations-hrms/): HR processes, employee data, HRMS, reporting, workflows and automation
- [Recruitment & Talent](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/recruitment-talent/): Recruitment process, role clarity, evaluation and hiring workflows
- [Fractional HR](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/fractional-hr/): Experienced HR leadership without a full-time senior hire
- [HR Outsourcing](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-outsourcing/): Defined external support across recurring HR operations and the employee lifecycle

## Focused starting points

- [HR Health Check](https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-health-check/): Small fixed-price review of one HR area, agreed upfront
- [Sales & CRM Health Check](https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-crm-health-check/): Small fixed-price review of one sales, CRM, distributor or city-expansion question
- [Readiness assessment](https://pathweave.in/diagnostic/): Free 15-question self-assessment across People, Process and Technology

## Founders

- [Srrinivas Sharrma](https://pathweave.in/about/srrinivas-sharrma/): Founder, leads BusinessOS; 18+ years in sales transformation, Sales Excellence, Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations and CRM transformation
- [Renu Dhanopia Sharma](https://pathweave.in/about/): Founder, leads PeopleOS; HR leadership, consulting and outsourced HR delivery across organisation structures, policies, recruitment, performance management, HR operations and people systems
